paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Predicting narrative frames using oracle (human-annotated) and noisy (predicted) labels for their , , , and ; the results are macro-averaged F1.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the macro-averaged F1 scores for predicting narrative frames using different models and prompts. The horizontal axis represents the models, which are Gemini, GPT4o, and Sonnet. The vertical axis represents the F1 scores, ranging from 0 to 0.7, with increments of 0.1. Each model has three bars corresponding to Basic prompt, Structured prompt + oracle, and Structured prompt + predicted, colored in blue, orange, and green, respectively. The blue bars for Basic prompt have values around 0.3 for Gemini, 0.25 for GPT4o, and 0.35 for Sonnet. The orange bars for Structured prompt + oracle have values approximately at 0.6 for Gemini, 0.58 for GPT4o, and 0.52 for Sonnet. The green bars for Structured prompt + predicted have values around 0.35 for Gemini, 0.45 for GPT4o, and 0.44 for Sonnet. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bar is visually emphasized.
